verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe GitHub's pull request workflow as 'a popular way to create and review code' (github-docs-69). They also cover reviewing a diff and then creating a pull request (github-docs-26), code review feedback with applicable suggested changes (github-docs-25), and reading, reviewing, and collaborating on PRs from mobile and the CLI (github-docs-86, github-docs-75). Together these clearly cover opening PRs and reviewing changes. missing for 10: explicit documentation of human inline line-level review comments and side-by-side diff comparison views, independent or hands-on corroboration of the PR review experience.
